mobbin:c89738be-2928-4ed1-94ac-f730f0426.summary: On Check In Guests, a checked-in guest's checkmark opens an Uncheck them? sheet; confirming Undo check-in returns them to a Check in button like unchecked guests.
steps: Check In Guests — checked vs Check in
List after undo — both show Check in
steal: Row state: filled checkmark vs outlined Check in pill (step 1) — presence readable without opening a card.
Confirm sheet titled Uncheck them? with guest avatar/name before Undo check-in (step 2) — deliberate reverse of tagging.
Nevermind dismiss beside Undo (step 2) — safe cancel for accidental taps.
Search Find a guest… above the list (step 1) — scales when many learners are on the roster.
avoid: RSVP emoji lines (Going / Maybe) as the secondary label (steps 1–3) — sim rooms need role/group, not party RSVP tone.
mobbin:c89738be-2928-4ed1-94ac-f730f0426.fit: Adds a confirm-before-untag step for room check-in outside SRV so wrong learner tags can be reversed without rewriting Annotation/transcript speaker labels by hand.
